maxListings.title: Maximum listings to scrape
maxListings.description: Maximum number of listings to scrape (0 = all available). The API provides all auctions at once, so this filters the results.

auctionStatus.title: Auction status filter
auctionStatus.description: Active = auctions still open for bidding or upcoming, not knocked down. Ended = auctions whose bidding has closed, knocked down or not (the API serves about the last three months). The database only receives active auctions; ended ones go to the dataset only.

priceMin.title: Minimum price filter (CZK)
priceMin.description: Minimum price filter in Czech Koruna. Applied after fetching all data from API.

priceMax.title: Maximum price filter (CZK)
priceMax.description: Maximum price filter in Czech Koruna. Applied after fetching all data from API.

location.title: Location filter
location.description: Optional location filter (city/region). Applied after fetching all data from API.

searchQuery.title: Search query filter
searchQuery.description: Optional search term to filter auction titles/descriptions. Applied after fetching all data from API.
